description: PMH-3046 is a high strength HDPE post-applied self-adhesive waterproofing membrane, designed for underground structure side walls and roof slabs, working together with PMH 3040/3040PLUS, PMH 3080/3080PLUS to form an integrated system for below-grade waterproofing. The high performing HDPE film laminated with an aggressive, pressure sensitive adhesive, which can form a full bond with most of construction materials, especially concrete structures. The high strength cross-laminated HDPE film can provide good puncture resistance and tear strength.
whereToUse: Acceptable substrates are exterior-grade gypsum sheathing, plywood, OSB, precast or cast-in-place concrete, concrete block, primed steel, aluminum mill finish, anodized aluminum and galvanized metal
advantages: Fully bonded to structural side wall
Non-asphaltic adhesive, compatible with Pre-applied PMH series membranes
Excellent mechanical performance: high strength, elongation, tear resistance
Good sealing to concrete shrinkage cracks, bridges and movements
Water and vapor barrier to all basements
notFor: Concrete must be cured a minimum of 14 days and must be dry before the membrane is applied
Where curing compounds are used, they must be clear resin based, without oil, wax or pigments
Excess moisture may lead to blistering of the membrane
Membrane can be applied between temperature -5℃ to 35℃

technicalData.label: Laps
technicalData.value: The membrane must be lapped a minimum of 2” (50 mm) on both sides and end laps

technicalData.label: Resistance to static loading (EN 12730:2001 method B)
Water tightness against heat aging (EN 1296:2001 & EN 1928:2000 method B)
Water tightness against chemicals (EN 1847:2009 & EN 1928:2000 method B)
Crack cycling at -26 C, 100 cycles (ASTM C836)
Water vapor transmission, water method (ASTM E96 method B)
Storage period
technicalData.value: the storage period is one year from the production date

mixing: If time is critical, YHPrimer-1000 can be used to allow priming and installation of membrane on damp surfaces or green concrete.
storage: It should be stored in a cool, ventilated, and dry warehouse, and kept away from fire sources.
